VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report claims all 19 tests pass, but provides no independent verification (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts). The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 19 tests pass," which cannot be verified from a self-report alone. Self-reports are the weakest evidence class and insufficient for confirming test passage, especially when the fix involves critical error handling in data ingestion.
